gating_findings.title: Story-loop adapter review scope can omit actual changed files
gating_findings.detail: The adapter review-scope parser includes later review-history bullets as File List entries and reported tracked_changed/untracked as empty even though git status and git diff showed uncommitted changes. Orchestrated review can therefore run without the actual scoped code.

gating_findings.title: Failed reviewer lanes can still pass story-loop completion
gating_findings.detail: The review workflow records failed or empty lanes but status gating only checks findings, and the validator accepts clean reports with failed fanout layers. A story can be marked done without all required review coverage.

gating_findings.title: Gating-priority findings can be deferred
gating_findings.detail: The story-loop present step allows defer findings to be checked off by category without explicitly forbidding P0/P1/P2 deferral, which can turn gating findings into a done outcome.

gating_findings.title: Story-loop blocker paths may omit a schema-valid report
gating_findings.detail: Missing target/spec and nested-fanout-unavailable blocker paths say to halt with a blocker, but do not guarantee a terminal ORCHESTRATOR_REPORT block. The orchestrator may receive no parseable terminal state.

gating_findings.title: Nested report shape requirements are underspecified
gating_findings.detail: The workflow lists the top-level ORCHESTRATOR_REPORT fields but does not spell out required nested object shapes and enum values, increasing schema-invalid report risk.

gating_findings.title: Untracked scoped files can be absent from reviewer diffs
gating_findings.detail: The uncommitted-diff path uses git diff HEAD and does not explicitly add synthetic diffs or direct inspection for untracked files that belong to the story scope.

gating_findings.title: Acceptance findings can use an invalid report source enum
gating_findings.detail: Triage names the Acceptance Auditor source as auditor, but the story-loop report schema expects acceptance. Acceptance findings can make strict report validation fail.

gating_findings.title: Step frontmatter can reset story-loop mode
gating_findings.detail: Multiple step files define orchestration_mode as interactive, so a step-level runtime reset can disable story-loop safeguards despite the caller-provided mode.

gating_findings.title: Decision-needed reports can leave blocked stories in review
gating_findings.detail: The validator accepts decision_needed reports with story_status_after=review, allowing blocked review work to be repeatedly reselected instead of moving back to in-progress for follow-up.

gating_findings.title: Preview parsing still materializes full-source rows before confirmation
gating_findings.detail: CSV and workbook preview paths still traverse full confirmed-row state before explicit confirm when the preview boundary is exceeded, threatening large-file preview latency and memory protections.

gating_findings.title: Missing persisted handle warnings can be suppressed
gating_findings.detail: Reopen warning generation checks unsanitized persisted handle entries before stricter hydration sanitation, so a handle that parses but later fails live validation can lose source-backed repair capability without a recovery issue.

gating_findings.title: Dropped handles can leave stale sourceFile metadata
gating_findings.detail: Save/reopen paths can keep sourceFile metadata when no prepared handle survives, so datasets can remain marked source-backed after the backing source handle is unavailable.

p3_findings.title: Large-diff story-loop wording can invite interactive chunking
p3_findings.detail: The gather-context step still says to offer chunking before its story-loop override, which can lead to accidental interactive behavior in a non-interactive worker.
p3_findings.p3_rationale: Low-risk workflow clarity issue that does not directly affect product acceptance, security, data integrity, or runtime correctness.
p3_findings.disposition_reason: Left as an action item because this review round contains unresolved decision-needed and P1/P2 findings.

p3_findings.title: Missing priority rationales are not synthesized during triage
p3_findings.detail: The workflow requires priority rationales in persisted findings but does not instruct triage to synthesize one when a reviewer lane omits it.
p3_findings.p3_rationale: Maintainability and report-quality issue only; it does not directly gate Story 2.2 acceptance.
p3_findings.disposition_reason: Left as an action item because this review round contains unresolved decision-needed and P1/P2 findings.

p3_findings.title: Preview replay contexts accumulate until route unmount
p3_findings.detail: Resolved previews are cached in an unbounded map and rejects do not prune stale entries, causing session-scoped memory growth across repeated preview/repair loops.
p3_findings.p3_rationale: Session-scoped memory/maintenance issue that does not directly violate acceptance criteria or create immediate data-integrity risk.
p3_findings.disposition_reason: Left as an action item because this review round contains unresolved decision-needed and P1/P2 findings.

decision_needed.title: Choose stale local-file provenance behavior
decision_needed.detail: confirmImport can reuse same-name pending handle provenance for a preview materialized from an older captured File object. A product/architecture decision is needed on whether to fail closed, strip local-file provenance, or require source reselection when the live handle no longer matches the previewed bytes.
options: Fail closed and require the user to reselect/repreview the source before confirm/save
Strip local-file provenance and allow confirm of the materialized dataset without a persisted handle
Require source reselection only when metadata or digest validation proves the handle changed

decision_needed.title: Choose hydration-failure write policy
decision_needed.detail: hydrateWorkspaceKernelStore exposes a writable bootstrap store after transient load or parse/install failures. A decision is needed on whether persisted hydration failures must fail closed or may fall back to bootstrap only while confirm/save is blocked until hydration succeeds.
options: Fail closed and block workspace writes until hydration succeeds or the user explicitly starts a new workspace
Allow bootstrap fallback only in read-only mode with confirm/save disabled until retry succeeds
Allow writable bootstrap fallback and accept overwrite risk

report.summary: Review completed with all four nested lanes completed. Story status and sprint-status entry were both updated to in-progress. Findings were recorded in the story R6 section; no fixes were applied. Full validation passed: typecheck, tests, lint, and build.

decision_resolutions.R6-D1: Fail closed and require the user to reselect/repreview the source before confirm/save
decision_resolutions.R6-D2: Fail closed and block workspace writes until hydration succeeds or the user explicitly starts a new workspace
